hint: Use "do" or "does" to form questions in present simple.
Correct structure: Do you like coffee?
Short answers in present simple use "do/does".
Correct structure: Does she work here?
Correct sentence: She is reading a book.
Past simple uses second form of verb.
Correct: She went to school yesterday.
Use past tense for yesterday/last night.
Correct: They watched a movie last night.
Correct: She did not go yesterday.
Correct: They did not watch TV.
Correct: I did not finish my work.
Correct: He did not play soccer.
